## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde walk to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school together while discussing their schoolmates and their beautiful surroundings. During afternoon classes, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her hair, prompting an enraged [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to smash her slate over his head.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038)_

> In class, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md) punishes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by forcing her to stand at the front of the room and later making her sit beside Hugh, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to declare that she will never return to school. Upon returning home, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) seeks advice from [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), who recommends letting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rest at home until her temper subsides.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)_

> Following Agatha's advice, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) decides not to force [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back to school, allowing her to study at home instead. Though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stubbornly refuses to forgive [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), she grows deeply attached to Isolde. [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) later finds [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) weeping dramatically over the imagined future heartbreak of Isolde marrying and leaving her, which moves [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to rare, genuine laughter.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gets permission from [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to host Isolde for an afternoon tea while [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) is away in [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford). When Isolde arrives, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) serves her several glasses of what she believes to be raspberry cordial. Isolde becomes dizzy and ill from the drink, forcing her to leave prematurely before they can even have tea.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) convinces [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) to let her stay at Isolde's and go to the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert. After enjoying the concert and performances, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde return to the [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) home late at night, where they inadvertently jump into bed on top of Isolde's visiting [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md).
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) is overjoyed by [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) gifts, including a new dress from [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) and slippers from Isolde's family. Later that night, following a successful [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school concert, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde discuss the evening's performances on their way home. Meanwhile, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) privately express their pride in Nell's performance and discuss her future education.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her friends act out the story of [Elaine](../character/elaine.md), with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) drifting down the pond in a flat-bottomed boat. The boat begins leaking and sinks, forcing [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to cling to a bridge pile until [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) rescues her in his dory. Afterward, Hugh asks for Nell's friendship, but she stubbornly refuses him before reuniting with her frightened friends.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) meets [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) and Isolde, who are relieved to find her alive after thinking she drowned during their reenactment. Later, back at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reflects on her past mistakes and vows to give up her excessive romanticism, though [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) quietly encourages her to keep a little of it.
>

> At [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) offered to include her in a special class to prepare for the Regent's entrance exam. Excited by the chance to train as a teacher, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accepts and joins the class alongside her peers, though she mourns that Isolde will not be participating with her.
>

> At school, Hugh silently competes with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) while ignoring her, leaving her to regret her past harshness as the term ends. Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) reassures the class that she will return next year, prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to happily lock away her books for summer vacation. Later, [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) visits [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and compliments Nell's growth and grace despite her initial misgivings.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) enjoys a relaxing, healthy summer after a doctor advises outdoor play to preserve her health. Returning to her studies in autumn, she works hard under Miss Thorne's guidance to prepare for the upcoming Entrance examination despite her growing anxieties. As she physically matures and reflects on her changes, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) experiences a bittersweet realization of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) growing up.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) completes her entrance examinations in town, staying with [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md), and returns to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) to anxiously await the results. After weeks of tense waiting, Isolde brings the newspaper showing that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) tied for first place on the island. Overjoyed, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares the glorious news with [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and Mrs. Sowerby.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) overcomes a wave of severe stage fright when she spots [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) smiling in the back of the hall, which spurs her determination not to let him mock her. Her initial recitation and encore earn high praise from the audience and notable attendees. Afterward, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) enjoy supper and depart together, reflecting cheerfully on the evening as [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) waits outside.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) prepares for her departure to Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), sharing an emotional goodbye with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). After arriving in town, she adjusts to her new surroundings and classes alongside students like [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) and [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md). Upon hearing news of an upcoming [Avery](../codex/places.md#avery) scholarship, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) sets her sights on winning it to pursue a college degree.

> [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) collapses and dies after receiving news of the bank failure, plunging [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) into mourning. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) grieves with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and converses with Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md) about life carrying on despite her loss. As routine returns, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chat on the porch about friends, future plans, and Thirza's past romance.
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) returns from the eye doctor with bad news that her vision is severely failing and she must avoid eye strain, prompting her to consider selling [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) insists on giving up her college scholarship to stay home, care for [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and teach locally so they can keep their home. Later, Mrs. Sowerby reveals that [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) selflessly withdrew his application for the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school so [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) could teach there, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) thanks Hugh when she runs into him.
>

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and later reflects contentedly at her window on her future path.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), and Hugh discuss their differing views on classroom discipline before beginning their upcoming teaching terms. Afterward, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks home to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), avoiding Mrs. Sowerby to instead converse with Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) about her plan to rule her school with affection. > [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) recounts her and Isolde's day of soliciting donations throughout [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) to [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), describing helpful and unhelpful encounters alike. She takes advantage of Lorenzo White's excitement over his new baby boy to secure a large donation. Finally, she attempts to get a contribution from Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), who turns her down.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh discuss their experiences teaching and their future ambitions before Hugh departs to run an errand. Afterwards, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) returns from visiting [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), expressing concern over Mary's failing health and the uncertain future of the Farrow twins. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) successfully convinces [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to take in the children for the winter out of a sense of duty, offering to handle their sewing.

Despite the catastrophic outcome, the community rallies behind the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and blames the [Tulks](../codex/factions.md#tulks) for the mistake.

Later, at a B.V.I.S. meeting, [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md) reveals that [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md) plans to rent his farm fence for commercial ads, sparking panic among the members.

Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally overhears Judson accepting a political bribe from [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), prompting Judson to drop the advertising plan to keep her silent.

At the graveyard, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) places flowers on the graves of [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) and [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md), then walks home with Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md), discussing her teaching, ideals, friendship, and future prospects.

Hugh visits [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to recount the panic at the school and discuss the damage with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).

Later, Mrs. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) expresses her gratitude over the paper's note, and Mrs. Sowerby chats with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) puts a sleepy [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to bed.

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a stack of letters from home containing updates from [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and news from her friends and family, including humorous local stories from Mrs. Sowerby.

She receives a letter from her friend [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) proposing that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), and [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) lease a house together for the upcoming school year. > [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) writes a story titled 'Evadne's Atonement', sharing her process and drafts with Isolde and seeking feedback from Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md). Both offer critiques on her plot, characters, and descriptions, though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) keeps her writing hidden from Hugh and [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). After mailing the manuscript to two different magazines, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives rejections from both and decides to give up her literary ambitions, despite Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) encouraging her to keep writing about what she knows.

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P35](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0035), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P38](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0038)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) feeling melancholic about her broken engagement and lost youth. She visits neighbors and friends, learning about recent local developments, wedding announcements, and births, which heightens her sense of loneliness.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

_Sources: [v3 ch.Weddings P0](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0000), [v3 ch.Weddings P25](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0025), [v3 ch.Weddings P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 ch.Weddings P51](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0051)_

> Hugh invites [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on a walk, which she defers to the following afternoon so she can finish preparing her dress for Alice Penhallow's wedding. The next day, Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walk together to [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md) Wren's garden, where Hugh confesses his enduring love and asks [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to marry him. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) happily accepts, clearing up past misunderstandings about [Rowena Calder](../character/rowena-calder.md) and [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md) before they walk home together.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XLI Love Takes Up the Glass of Time

_Sources: [v3 ch.Time P0](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0000), [v3 ch.Time P15](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0015), [v3 ch.Time P22](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0022), [v3 ch.Time P25](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0025)_

> In the attic at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Isolde Duckett](../character/isolde-duckett.md) chat about Nell's upcoming marriage to [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) and her move to [Seven Gulls Harbor](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-harbor). They reflect on their past, Isolde's young daughter [Small Nell Lucinda](../character/small-nell-lucinda.md), and the local gossips of [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P6](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P16](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0016)_

> At [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) excitedly prepare gifts for Nell's upcoming wedding to [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md). Visitors come to congratulate [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), including [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), Mrs. [Gorham Pullen](../character/gorham-pullen.md), and Mrs. Jasper Bell, who offer mixed well-wishes. Later, Hugh visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and they joyfully discuss the historic house in [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls) he has secured for them to live in.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P0](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P9](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P15](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P20](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0020)_

> [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh at the house of dreams, where she relaxes and enjoys fudge, conversation, and their collection of books. Before leaving, she promises to return, though her demeanor turns cold and somber upon realizing what she lacks in life. Afterward, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh discuss Lorna's beauty and affirm their love for each other.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 12 LORNA COMES OVER

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 12 LORNA COMES OVER P0](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LORNA COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LORNA COMES OVER P13](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LORNA COMES OVER P21](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0021)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh spend autumn evenings at the lighthouse with Captain Saul and [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), engaging in conversations and listening to stories. Walking home together afterward, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh affectionately discuss Lorna's potential, their own happiness, and their shared home as they look forward to spring.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P2](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P6](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P7](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P16](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0016)_

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) comes to stay at the house to help [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) during her pregnancy and labor. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gives birth to a baby girl, whom she names [Joyce](../character/joyce.md), but the baby dies shortly after birth, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh devastated. The community grieves with them as [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) slowly recovers while mourning her loss.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P12](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P21](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0021)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) waits on the foggy sandbar while Hugh goes to the fishing cove and encounters a distressed [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) walking alone. [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) confesses to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that she has secretly fallen in love with [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) and is heartbroken by his cold departure. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) comforts her and keeps Adrian's feelings secret, before Hugh returns to take them both home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR P6](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR P11](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR P19](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR P36](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0036)_

> Hugh discusses with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) his belief that an operation could restore Rufus Vane's sanity and memory, arguing that it is his medical duty to inform [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) strongly opposes the idea, arguing that telling [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) would unfairly burden her and ruin her life, though Hugh remains firm in his conviction.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 29 HUGH AND NELL DISAGREE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 29 HUGH AND NELL DISAGREE P10](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 29 HUGH AND NELL DISAGREE P12](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 29 HUGH AND NELL DISAGREE P15](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 29 HUGH AND NELL DISAGREE P16](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0016)_

> [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) secures funds from Captain Saul and travels to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) with Hugh and Rufus for the surgery. After returning home, Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receive a letter from [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) with a shocking revelation: the man they believed to be Rufus for twelve years is actually his cousin, [Laurence Vane](../character/laurence.md), while the real Rufus died in Cuba long ago.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P8](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gives birth to a healthy baby boy, bringing deep comfort to her and Hugh after their earlier loss. Friends and family gather to admire the newborn, whom they decide to name [James Obed](../character/james-obed.md). Afterward, [Winifred](../character/winifred-tolley.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) plans to visit [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), bringing up hopes for Lorna's future.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P1](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P6](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P30](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0030)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh discuss recent news about old acquaintances before [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) arrives with bad news about her sister's broken leg, prompting [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) to temporarily move in. Miss Winifred approves of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) staying with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) while [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) visits. Adrian later arrives, unsettling [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), but [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reassures her that Adrian has come for her and that happiness lies ahead.
>

They discuss his character, religion, political affiliation, and details about the wedding attire while exchanging playful advice.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P4](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P8](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P20](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0020), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P26](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0026)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) deliver [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) and [James](../character/james-a.md) Garrick's finished book to Captain Saul, who celebrates its arrival with tea and cake. The next morning, Hugh notices that the lighthouse light is still burning past sunrise. Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) hasten to the lighthouse, where they find Captain Saul has peacefully passed away with his life-book open on his chest.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) transition Little Kit into short clothes, and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) shares news that Adrian plans to buy the house for summer holidays. When moving day arrives in October, the house is packed up and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) tearfully says a final goodbye to her beloved home before departing with Hugh.
